title: When the Enemy Attacks but God Prevails
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor shares a gripping account of a life-threatening spiritual attack and how he stood firm in faith, refusing to give in to the enemy's schemes. Learn how Pastor's unwavering trust in God's power and Word led to a miraculous healing, and discover the secrets to overcoming even the most intense spiritual battles. Don't miss this inspiring and faith-building message that will leave you equipped to face any challenge that comes your way.
